_about: FAKE answer packet for the agent-fill experiment (docs/agent-fill-experiment.md, Step 2). Same made-up person as bench.PERSONA, plus screening answers for someone based in Toronto. Never the user's real data.
rules: Use only the values in this packet. Never invent a value.
If a question isn't covered, choose a 'prefer not to say' or 'decline to answer' option if one exists; otherwise leave it blank.
List every question you left blank or declined in your final report under 'unanswered'.
For dropdowns and radio buttons, choose the option that means the same as the packet value.
Never click Submit, Send, Sign in, Log in, Create account or Register, and never type a password.
